label: Deploy: a test target (staging) must not share prod's data, database, mail, sign-in key, seal key or payment keys

params.name: guarded
params.label: Targets (chip deploy.settings) checked before every deploy / init

params.name: against
params.label: The target they must not share anything with (its folder and service from chip deploy.settings; DEPLOY_<TARGET>_BASE / _SERVICE override one run)

params.name: env_files
params.label: Where a target's settings are read from: KEY=VALUE lines and systemd Environment= lines ({base}, {service}, {unit_dir})

params.name: same_refused
params.label: Settings that may never hold the same value on both (the database connection string = chip store.engine url_env; the one sign-in key; the seal key)

params.name: same_refused_prefixes
params.label: Every setting starting so (a credential, a per-site sign-in key) may never hold the same value on both

params.name: data_env
params.label: The setting naming the data folder (else <base>/data); the two folders may never be the same

params.name: seal_file_env
params.label: The setting naming a target's seal key file (chip store.seal key_file_env)

params.name: seal_key_file
params.label: The seal key beside each data folder (chip store.seal key_file): the same key on both is refused

params.name: smtp_file
params.label: The mail settings file in each data folder

params.name: smtp_fields
params.label: The same mail server AND login on both is refused (staging would mail real people as prod)

params.name: live_marks
params.label: A guarded target's setting whose value holds one of these is a LIVE payment key (rzp_live_, sk_live_, pk_live_) - test keys only

default.live: {target} holds a live payment key in {name} - a test target takes test keys only
default.unread: cannot read {path} to compare it - run the deploy as root
default.refused: DEPLOY REFUSED - {target} is not separate from {against} (chip deploy.separation):

description_nl: DomainTemplate 2026-11-18 gap audit C1-14: deploy/deploy.sh --target staging ran the same steps on the same VPS and nothing checked that staging had its own data, database, mail, sign-in key or payment keys. deploy/separation.py reads this chip for each guarded target and the one it is guarded against, and refuses (exit 1, every reason listed) when the data folders are the same, a same_refused / prefixed setting holds the same value, the seal keys are the same, the mail server + login are the same, or a guarded target holds a live payment key. Guards: selfcheck part deploy (separation self-test) and deploy/harness/dryrun.sh case 'staging pointing at prod'.

words.live: {target} holds a live payment key in {name} - a test target takes test keys only
words.unread: cannot read {path} to compare it - run the deploy as root
words.refused: DEPLOY REFUSED - {target} is not separate from {against} (chip deploy.separation):
